cohort: The study included 200 patients diagnosed with placental abruption who underwent cesarean delivery at a single center between January 2015 and December 2018.
finding: Fibrinogen levels prior to delivery, gestational age, smoking, and maternal systolic blood pressure were independent predictors for fetal and neonatal mortality in subjects with placental abruption.
gest_age: Gestational age at delivery (specific values not provided)
